title: Keyboard and Mouse
parentNote: Let your child practice on a real (or toy) keyboard and mouse while going through this unit — feeling where the Space bar, Enter, and Backspace keys actually are makes these questions stick much better than reading alone.
learnBullets: Important keyboard keys: **Space bar, Enter, Backspace, Shift, Caps Lock, Arrow keys**
Mouse actions: **click, double-click, right-click, scroll, drag**
Which key or mouse action to use for a given task
learnItFirst:
**Keyboard keys:**
| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Space bar | Leaves a space between words (the longest key!) |
| Enter | Moves to a new line / confirms |
| Backspace | Erases the letter BEFORE the cursor |
| Shift | Types a CAPITAL letter while held down |
| Caps Lock | Locks typing to ALL CAPITAL letters |
| Arrow keys | Move the cursor up, down, left, right |

**Mouse actions:**
| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| Click | Selects or presses something once |
| Double-click | Click twice quickly — opens a file or icon |
| Right-click | Opens a menu with more options |
| Scroll (wheel) | Moves the page up or down |
| Drag | Click, hold, and move something across the screen |

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Picture** what needs to happen (a space? a capital letter? opening a game?).
2. **Match** it to the ONE key or mouse action that does exactly that.
3. **Double-check**: keyboard keys are for typing; mouse actions are for pointing, clicking, and selecting.

---

questions.content: Which key do we press to leave a SPACE between two words?
questions.why: The Space bar leaves a space between words

questions.content: Which part of the mouse do we press to select something?
questions.why: We press the mouse button to select something

questions.content: Moving the mouse moves the ___ on the screen.
questions.why: Moving the mouse moves the pointer on the screen

questions.content: Which key do we press to move to a NEW LINE while typing?
questions.why: The Enter key moves typing to a new line

questions.content: The keyboard has keys for letters, numbers, and:

options.B: Special keys like Enter and Space bar

questions.why: Keyboards have letters, numbers, and special keys

questions.content: To erase the letter you just typed, which key do you press?
questions.why: Backspace erases the letter just typed

questions.content: Clicking the mouse button TWICE quickly is called a:
questions.why: Clicking twice quickly is called a double-click

questions.content: Which of these is used to type letters and numbers?
questions.why: The keyboard is used for typing

questions.content: The Caps Lock key helps us type letters in:
questions.why: Caps Lock makes every letter capital while it's on

questions.content: Which key is usually the LONGEST key on the keyboard?
questions.why: The Space bar is the longest key on the keyboard

questions.content: Pressing the Shift key while typing a letter gives us a:
questions.why: Shift + a letter key types a capital letter

questions.content: The 4 keys used to move the cursor up, down, left, and right are called the:
questions.why: The 4 direction keys are called arrow keys

questions.content: Which mouse action opens a file or program by clicking twice quickly?
questions.why: Double-clicking opens a file or program

questions.content: Which part of the mouse helps us scroll up and down a page?
questions.why: The scroll wheel moves the page up and down

questions.content: Clicking, holding, and moving the mouse to shift a picture on the screen is called:
questions.why: Click, hold, and move — this is dragging

questions.content: Right-clicking the mouse usually:

options.B: Opens a menu with more options

questions.why: Right-click usually shows a menu

questions.content: Which key erases the letter that comes BEFORE the cursor when typing?
questions.why: Backspace erases the letter before the cursor

questions.content: On a keyboard, the top row of letter keys usually starts with the letters:

options.A: Q, W, E, R, T, Y
options.C: A, B, C, D, E, F

questions.why: This is the standard top row of a keyboard

questions.content: Which of these do you use to click and select an item on the screen?
questions.why: The mouse is used to click and select

questions.content: Which key confirms what you typed and moves to the next line?
questions.why: Enter confirms and moves to a new line

questions.content: If Caps Lock is turned ON and you press the letter "a" key, what happens?
questions.why: Caps Lock makes all letters capital while it's on

questions.content: Which of these is TRUE about a mouse?

options.A: It is used only for printing
options.B: It helps us point, click, and select things on the screen
options.D: It has no buttons at all

questions.why: This describes what a mouse does

questions.content: To type the number "5", which type of key would you press?
questions.why: Number keys are used to type numbers

questions.content: Clicking and dragging the mouse to select many letters or words at once is called:
questions.why: Clicking and moving the mouse to select is dragging

questions.content: Which of these is NOT something you do with a mouse?
questions.why: Typing letters is done with the keyboard, not the mouse

questions.content: Priya wants to type "Hi" with a capital "H" and small "i". Which key should she hold while typing "H"?
questions.why: Holding Shift while typing a letter makes it capital

questions.content: Which of these correctly matches a keyboard key to its use?

options.D: Enter — moves to a new line

questions.why: This is the correct match

questions.content: Sam typed "helllo" by mistake (with an extra "l"). Which key should he use to fix it?

options.D: Backspace, to delete the extra letter

questions.why: Backspace removes the mistyped letter

questions.content: Meena wants to open a game icon on the screen using the mouse. What should she do?
questions.why: Double-clicking an icon opens it

questions.content: Which of these correctly matches a mouse action to what it does?

options.B: Right-click — opens a menu with more options
options.C: Left-click alone — always deletes a file

questions.why: This is the correct match
